text:
Casey (CSM): Heads-up 1 — Iris just launched SmartReplies on Apr 28 and we're seeing an embeddings + gen spike. QBR next Mon, need a 1-slide cost summary + recommended plays.
Monique (FinOps): Pulling numbers now. 5d burn +185% vs prior baseline. If sustained month -> ~$62k vs baseline $22k. Running a 30d sensitivity.
quota-bot: Budget alert triggered for account: iris-app 1 daily spend crossed soft threshold (5k) at 2026-04-30T08:47Z.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Likely factors: per-message embedding calls combined with generation for contextual replies. Two lever ideas: 1) client-side batching for embeddings, 2) switch non-critical flows to emb-small / gen-light.
Dev (Onboarding): I'll request top 1k queries and the deploy changelog. Can we pre-send a checklist so eng brings the right logs?
Monique (FinOps): Quick modeled scenarios: baseline monthly $22,000; sustained spike $62,000; mitigated w/plays (batching + emb-small + sampling) ~$31,500. Risk if nothing done: renewal sensitivity flagged.
Casey (CSM): Good. Need concrete asks for the QBR: quota tweak, short credit ask, and enablement session. Alex/Monique 1 please give 2-3 plays with conservative savings estimates.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Plays: (A) Batch embeddings (client/server) -> -25-45% depending on hit size. (B) Trial emb-dim reduction 768->384 for UI -> ~-30% on embedding cost for those flows. (C) Gen-light variant for ephemeral replies -> -20% tokens. Also add prefix KV caching for repeated contexts.
Monique (FinOps): Add financial plays: soft cap = avg_daily *1.25, hard cap = avg_daily *2. Short-term credit: propose 3 days covering 50% of estimated overrun to avoid churn while fixes roll out.
Iris Success Admin: Confirming SmartReplies toggled on Apr 28 at 02:13 UTC. We'll pull the top queries and assign an engineer to attend enablement.
Dev (Onboarding): Scheduled enablement invite Tue 10:30 PT. Checklist in invite: top 1k queries, 2k sample calls, deploy commits, and a short diagram of SmartReplies flow.
Casey (CSM): For the QBR slide please include: 1) 30s summary + delta numbers, 2) plays with % savings & owners, 3) enablement plan & timing, 4) asks (quota, credits, follow-up date).
Alex (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the plays slide with conservative estimates and short curl examples. ETA EOD. Example batch snippet to show:
```
POST /v1/embeddings/batch
[ {"input": ["text1","text2"], "model": "gpt-emb-small"} ]
```
Monique (FinOps): I'll attach the 30d forecast and runway scenarios. Quick calc I used:
```// simplified
avg_daily = 1900
spike_multiplier = 3.2
projected_month = avg_daily * spike_multiplier * 30
```
Casey (CSM): Actions: Monique -> final 30d forecast + credit recommendation (EOD). Alex -> plays slide + examples (EOD). Dev -> collect logs + run enablement Tue. I'll assemble QBR deck and circulate draft tomorrow AM.
Iris Success Admin: Appreciate the fast response. We'll prioritize the sample export and confirm engineering attendees.
Casey (CSM): If they need an immediate stop-gap we can enable sampling on SmartReplies route: `PATCH /v1/accounts/iris/routes/smartreplies { "sample_rate": 0.25 }` to drop live gen volume. Also can push a temporary quota: `POST /v1/accounts/iris/quotas { "daily": 38000 }` (example).
Monique (FinOps): Flagging renewal risk if monthly runrate stays >2x baseline for 30d. Including sensitivity bands in the deck.
Alex (Solutions Eng): One more low-effort test: enable client-side dedupe for repeated prompts, often saves ~10-15% tokens immediately. I'll include a checklist for eng in the play slide.
Casey (CSM): Thanks all. I'll post the deck link here once it's ready. Closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
